intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hopper Computer Lab, long after dark. Rows of humming machines, and one screen still on. Someone in a long coat is typing very, very fast.

hello.speaker: cpp
hello.text: You. The door was closed. How did you even get in here?

choices.text: A rubber duck told me to come in.

duck.speaker: cpp
duck.text: Of course it did. Ducks. ...Fine. You're a CS freshman? Then prove it.

tour.speaker: cpp
tour.text: This lab is not a tour stop. ...Fine. You're a CS freshman? Then prove it.

teach.speaker: cpp
teach.text: std::cout is the console. Character output. You don't ask it to print. You push text into it with <<.

teach_2.speaker: cpp
teach_2.text: I already wrote the include and main for you. One line. Print Hello, world! And don't make me wait.

passed.speaker: cpp
passed.text: It compiles. It runs. Don't look so proud, it's one line. ...I'm Ciel. Ciel Vector. The C is pronounced like the letter.

passed_2.speaker: cpp
passed_2.text: Close the door on your way out. ...Or don't. The lab's open late.

failed.speaker: cpp
failed.text: Wrong. Read the output. Then read your line. Then read it again.
